meta.name: Smallstep PKI & Apple-Astryx Design DNA
meta.description: Engineered, authoritative cryptographic infrastructure design profile marrying Apple Pro hardware aesthetics, visionOS acrylic glass, and high-performance developer ergonomics.
source_references: Apple WWDC The Details of UI Typography

primary.role: System Blue / Primary Actions & Interactive Links

accent.role: Vivid Green / Authority Active Status Indicators

neutral.usage: Pure #000000 deep OLED background; #1c1c20 for translucent acrylic card bodies; #86868b for metadata; #f5f5f7 and #ffffff for crisp high-contrast headings and values

color.contrast_strategy: WCAG AA compliant (minimum 4.5:1 text contrast ratio against dark glass)

font_families.heading: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Display', 'SF Pro Text', 'Helvetica Neue', sans-serif
font_families.mono: 'SF Mono', Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

typography.font_style_notes: Optical sizing with negative tracking on headings; monospace reserved for hashes, CLI commands, SANs, and PEM certificates

spacing.section_rhythm: 32px section gaps with 28px to 38px internal card padding

layout.alignment_tendency: Left-aligned content with centered capsule tab navigations

shape.border_usage: 1px translucent outer border (rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08)) with 1px top specular highlight (rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16))

elevation.shadow_style: Deep ambient diffuse shadows imitating physical light diffusion
elevation.depth_cues: Chamfered top specular highlight creates physical depth over pure black OLED backgrounds

motion.philosophy: Zero latency feedback on pointer-down (:active { transform: scale(0.96) })

components.button_style: Capsule pills with instant pointer-down scale feedback and radiant glows
components.input_style: Dark translucent recessed inputs with crisp glowing focus rings
components.card_style: Chamfered frosted glass panels with specular top highlights and backdrop blur
components.modal_style: Centered blurred scrim with spring settle
components.list_style: Row-based table with hairline dividers and hover highlight

aesthetic.visual_metaphor: Apple Pro hardware meets mission-critical PKI terminal
aesthetic.era_influence: Modern macOS Sequoia & visionOS glass aesthetics

visual_language.ornamentation: Minimal (specular edges and neon status indicators only)
visual_language.whitespace_usage: Generous interior padding with tight informational clusters
visual_language.visual_weight_distribution: Anchored by dark surfaces, punctuated by vivid status dots
visual_language.focal_strategy: Primary CTA highlighted in vibrant system blue (#0a84ff)
visual_language.contrast_level: High contrast WCAG AA text over deep dark surfaces
visual_language.texture_usage: Subtle radial ambient spotlight over pure black

composition.balance_type: Asymmetric balanced metrics with centered layout
composition.flow_direction: Top-to-bottom scan with horizontal capsule tab filtering
composition.negative_space_role: Eliminates visual fatigue during active monitoring

interaction_feel.transition_personality: Critically damped spring (no rubbery cartoon bounce)
interaction_feel.microinteraction_density: High (every button, tab, and copy action provides instant visual cue)

overview.fallback_strategy: Solid dark background when backdrop-filter is unsupported

background_effects.description: Soft blue light cone cast downward from top center

text_effects.description: Negative tracking scaling inversely with font size
